title.narrative: Envelope 1: Enhance access to equitable lifesaving comprehensive services through integrated response focusing on camps, widows’ camps and nearby areas to ensure emergency services in Northwest Syria (NWS.)

description.narrative:
In order to ensure the continuity of emergency services in NWS, and to achieve access to life-saving humanitarian assistance, MF seeks through this project to enhance access to equitable lifesaving and life‐sustaining comprehensive services to 42,707 BNF/8649 HHs through integrated response of Protection (GBV amp CP), ER amp CCCM focusing on camps, widows' camps and nearby areas.
The planned intervention will be in line with the 2nd SA strategy and sectors priorities and harmonize with prioritized locations and respective clusters recommended activities under envelop1, within 25 Camps - Annex1. As MF has a current project under 2022 1st SA, targeting 11 widows' camps with Protection (CP amp GBV) and ER activities which showed a great positive impact on women and girls living in those camps and the surrounding ones, Maram will work through this project to enhance these activities within the same camps. In addition, to expand its activities to include additional widows’ camps and other nearby camps with integration response.
The project will support the livelihoods and access to services in line with the inter‐cluster action plan for widows’ camps. Also, it will ensure strong and joint cooperation with the ongoing project. this will be through safe referrals, identification of cases, and implementation of GBV activities for widows and CP activities for their children like life skills, parenting programs, resilience programs. etc. The project will address the current gaps in GBV services, especially GBV survivors who may also have CP cases, through case fund and IPA services, in additional the role of ER will be to secure job opportunities that guarantee them income-generating work that survivors can rely on and mitigate the impact of child labor or exploitation of children or school dropout and family separation that may occur due to lack of incomes. MF will adapt activities that integrate PWDs with their peers as well as the project will ensure when targeting disabled children using accessible and inclusive communication methods. Also, there will be an integration of services between the current project and this project by activating referral pathways for MHPSS and legal assistance. The project will consider CPamp GBV cases in the BNF selection process for vocational training and the small grants distribution.
The project will also support livelihoods and access to services in line with winterization and flood preparedness and response plan through emergency repairs of basic infrastructures, including road rehabilitation roads, drainage, and sewage systems (inamp outside camps), this intervention will be based on needs on the ground upon issuing an alert from the referred governorate, thus this emergency road rehabilitation interventions based upon alerts from the field, specifically coming from the Widows Camps, and from Northern Aleppo area.
Also, it will be in line with Health‐ERL Clusters coordination on cholera response, through direct support to CTCs, includes rehabilitation and gravelling of access roads to centers, also the waiting areas inside centers, ensuring PWD friendly facilities through providing ramps and provision of wheelchairs, and construction of lighting poles inside and around the centers.
For more complementary, and as for CCCM component, mainly related to emergency preparedness and fire response, it will be by establishing fire points, developing fire warden systems, supporting existing fire committees, providing fire response resources (including fire extinguishers and FAK), and providing trainings and awareness raising.
Consequently, the intervention will enhance the integration of services within the same locations and will ensure providing the emergency services and seek to enhancing access to equitable lifesaving comprehensive Pro, ER ampCCCM response. Taking into account the strategic cross-cutting elements throughout the project cycle including gender, PSEAamp AAP to ensure inclusion.
